crossRefs.note: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove…
Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…
I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do…
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I…
For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

translations.web: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
translations.bsb: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
translations.kjv: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
translations.asv: So then neither is he that planteth anything, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
